outcome: Pelvic floor structure (muscle defects, uterus-vagina angles, landmarks on pelvic MRI)
finding: Women who had vaginal deliveries had significantly higher rates of levator ani muscle defects and larger uterocervical angles compared to women who had cesarean sections, suggesting greater pelvic floor trauma with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal delivery was associated with a higher risk of pelvic floor trauma compared to cesarean section.
